"""Run at repo root. Reuse saved captures; inspect missing native Foam supports."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT/'src')]
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/s11-water-foam-support-mpl')
import cv2
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import DetectorSettings
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.preprocessing import preprocess
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.foam_front_detector import detect_bottom_connected_foam
from tests.diagnostics.s11_foam_support_geometry import measure_boundary_faces, BOUNDARY_SPEC

OUT = ROOT/'sample/output/s11-water-foam-support-20261010-002'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(name, value):
    (OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

qualification_path = ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-10-water-first-source-qualification.json'
reply_path = ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-10-water-foam-role-reply.json'
old_path = ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-retained-support-boundaries.json'
qualification = json.loads(qualification_path.read_text())
reply = json.loads(reply_path.read_text())
old = json.loads(old_path.read_text())['experiments']['measurement']['files']
old_pre, old_read = old['preflight.json']['content'], old['readout.json']['content']
assert reply['context_sha256'] == sha(qualification_path)
assert reply['reply_verbatim'] == 'A는 거품층이야' and reply['marked_frame'] == 1232
cases = qualification['preflight']['cases']
settings = DetectorSettings()
assert dataclasses.asdict(settings) == old_pre['settings_public']
source_pins = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sorted((ROOT/'src').rglob('*.py'))}
assert source_pins == old_pre['source_pins'], 'Reused production source has drifted'
reuse_ids = {0: 's5-empty-native', 822: 's5-inclined-native', 1643: 's5-settled-native'}
reuse = {n: next(r for r in old_read['results'] if r['case_id'] == key) for n, key in reuse_ids.items()}
inputs = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in [qualification_path, reply_path, old_path]}
inputs['tests/diagnostics/s11_foam_support_geometry.py'] = sha(ROOT/'tests/diagnostics/s11_foam_support_geometry.py')
inputs[reply['video']] = reply['video_sha256']
for case in cases:
    source = case['source_raster']
    inputs[source['path']] = source['sha256']
for row in reuse.values():
    inputs[row['arrays_path']] = row['arrays_sha256']
for name, pin in {**inputs, **source_pins}.items():
    assert sha(ROOT/name) == pin, name
crop_xyxy = qualification['preflight']['geometry']['crop_xyxy']
ox, oy, ex, ey = crop_xyxy
regions = qualification['preflight']['measurement']['regions']
preflight = dict(
    schema='s11-water-foam-support-preflight-v1',
    base_head='785579119d25ff83486e52a2b0e967cf9b111111',
    purpose='After the A/f1232 Foam reply, inspect whether unchanged retained appearance represents '
            'its current upper/lower alternatives, without selecting or defining physical boundaries.',
    inputs=inputs, production_source_pins=source_pins, runner_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
    cases=cases, qualification=qualification['source_qualification'], reply=reply,
    reused_capture_frames=list(reuse), new_capture_frames=[c['frame_index'] for c in cases if c['frame_index'] not in reuse],
    settings=dataclasses.asdict(settings), geometry=dict(crop_xyxy=crop_xyxy, source_origin_xy=[ox,oy],
        source_column_x=950, calibrated_glass_center=False, resize=False, recipe=None),
    new_capture_entry='Native crop -> preprocess(default settings, all-255 rectangular effective mask) '
        '-> isolated detect_bottom_connected_foam capture ON/OFF. Retain component diagnostics, labels '
        'and effective AND NOT preprocessing-glare visibility, as in the earlier support-face owner.',
    reused_capture_entry='Exact prior three native captures. Settings and every production source pin '
        'must match before reuse; verify source crop equality. No detector rerun of these three.',
    measurement=dict(boundary_spec=BOUNDARY_SPEC,
        rule='Enumerate all existing retained-support faces at source origin; preserve all labels, '
             'holes, censored neighbours and all horizontal faces at X950. No top/bottom pairing or scalar selection.',
        context_rectangles=regions, rectangle_scope='Previously fixed display/context only; counts are retained '
             'support occupancy, never dense Foam labels, homogeneity or physical-layer membership.'),
    physical_scope='Human Foam presence applies only to the regional A/f1232 feature. All other human '
        'judgments retain their own scope. Current source-column crossings and component front rows '
        'are representation values, not accepted target contours or candidate recall.',
    figures=dict(full_frame=1232, context_frames=[0,822,1232,1438,1643],
                 focus_xyxy=[780,440,1130,560], all_components=True),
    stop_rule='Keep all ten results. No cleanup, material union, mask, threshold, selector, reference '
        'or support grouping change in this readout. Missing/ambiguous physical membership stays unresolved.',
    physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED', production_change=False, video_decode=False,
    partition='development', no_new_mechanism=True,
)
write('preflight.json', preflight)
(OUT/'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())

results, display = [], {}
for case in cases:
    n = case['frame_index']; source = case['source_raster']
    im = cv2.imread(str(ROOT/source['path']), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    sx, sy = source['source_origin_xy']
    crop = im[oy-sy:ey-sy, ox-sx:ex-sx].copy()
    assert crop.shape == (830,420,3)
    if n in reuse:
        oldrow = reuse[n]
        with np.load(ROOT/oldrow['arrays_path'], allow_pickle=False) as saved:
            assert np.array_equal(crop, saved['crop'])
            labels, visible = saved['labels'].copy(), saved['visible'].copy()
        metadata = oldrow['owner_component_metadata']
        assert oldrow['capture_plain_equal'] is True
        mode = 'REUSED_VERIFIED_CAPTURE'
    else:
        mask = np.full(crop.shape[:2],255,np.uint8)
        pp = preprocess(crop, mask, settings)
        args = (crop,pp.gray,pp.canny,pp.glare_mask,mask,settings)
        before = [hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest() for a in args[:-1]]
        captured = detect_bottom_connected_foam(*args,capture_diagnostics=True)
        plain = detect_bottom_connected_foam(*args)
        for field in dataclasses.fields(captured):
            if field.name in ('diagnostics','diagnostic_labels'):
                continue
            a, b = getattr(captured,field.name), getattr(plain,field.name)
            assert np.array_equal(a,b) if isinstance(a,np.ndarray) else a==b, (n,field.name)
        assert before == [hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest() for a in args[:-1]]
        labels, visible, metadata = captured.diagnostic_labels, pp.glare_mask==0, captured.diagnostics
        mode = 'NEW_CAPTURE_EQUAL_ON_OFF'
    assert not metadata['truncated']
    assert set(np.unique(labels))-{0} == {c['diagnostic_id'] for c in metadata['components']}
    for component in metadata['components']:
        assert int(np.count_nonzero(labels==component['diagnostic_id'])) == component['pixel_count']
    faces = measure_boundary_faces(labels,visible,origin=(ox,oy))
    path = OUT/f'f{n:06d}.npz'
    face_arrays = {k:v for k,v in faces.items() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray)}
    np.savez_compressed(path,crop=crop,labels=labels,visible=visible,**face_arrays)
    crossings = (faces['owner_pixel_xy'][:,0]==950) & (faces['outward_normal_xy'][:,0]==0)
    center = [dict(diagnostic_id=int(faces['inside_label'][i]),
                   source_y=float(faces['start_xy2'][i,1]/2),
                   normal_y=int(faces['outward_normal_xy'][i,1]),
                   status=faces['status_names'][int(faces['status'][i])],
                   outside_label=int(faces['outside_label'][i])) for i in np.flatnonzero(crossings)]
    component_rows = []
    for c in metadata['components']:
        diag_id=c['diagnostic_id']; pixels=labels==diag_id
        contextual={}
        for name,box in regions.items():
            x0,y0,x1,y1=box
            sl=(slice(y0-oy,y1-oy),slice(x0-ox,x1-ox))
            contextual[name]=dict(retained_pixels=int(pixels[sl].sum()),
                                   visible_retained_pixels=int((pixels[sl]&visible[sl]).sum()))
        component_rows.append(dict(diagnostic_id=diag_id,pixel_count=c['pixel_count'],
            source_bbox_xyxy=[c['local_bbox_xyxy'][0]+ox,c['local_bbox_xyxy'][1]+oy,
                             c['local_bbox_xyxy'][2]+ox,c['local_bbox_xyxy'][3]+oy],
            component_front_source_y=c['local_front_y']+oy,
            front_from_lower_edge=c['predicates']['front_from_lower_edge'],
            diagnostic_rank_one=bool(c['selected_component']),
            decision_status=c['decision_status'],context_occupancy=contextual))
    row=dict(case_id=case['case_id'],frame_index=n,capture_mode=mode,capture_plain_equal=True,
        component_count=metadata['component_count'],retained_count=metadata['retained_count'],
        capture_truncated=metadata['truncated'],retained_pixels=int(np.count_nonzero(labels)),
        visible_retained_pixels=int(np.count_nonzero((labels!=0)&visible)),
        face_count=len(faces['status']),
        face_status_counts={name:int(np.count_nonzero(faces['status']==i)) for i,name in enumerate(faces['status_names'])},
        all_center_crossings=center,component_summary=component_rows,owner_component_metadata=metadata,
        arrays_path=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),arrays_sha256=sha(path),
        physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED',selected_physical_boundary=None,selected_scalar=None)
    results.append(row);display[n]=(crop,labels,visible,faces)
    print(n,mode,'components',row['retained_count'],'faces',row['face_count'],'crossings',len(center),flush=True)

def panels(axes,n,focus=False):
    crop,labels,visible,faces=display[n]
    extent=(ox-.5,ex-.5,ey-.5,oy-.5)
    axes[0].imshow(crop[:,:,::-1],extent=extent,interpolation='nearest')
    axes[1].imshow(np.ma.masked_where(labels==0,labels),cmap='tab20',extent=extent,interpolation='nearest')
    axes[1].set_facecolor('black')
    axes[2].imshow(crop[:,:,::-1],extent=extent,interpolation='nearest')
    seg=np.stack([faces['start_xy2'],faces['end_xy2']],axis=1)/2
    colors=np.array(['cyan','yellow','magenta','red'])[faces['status']]
    axes[2].add_collection(LineCollection(seg,colors=colors,linewidths=.65))
    for ax,title in zip(axes,['clean original','all retained labels (colors repeat)','all support faces; magenta/red = censored']):
        ax.set_title(f'f{n} / '+title,fontsize=9)
        if focus:
            x0,y0,x1,y1=preflight['figures']['focus_xyxy'];ax.set_xlim(x0-.5,x1-.5);ax.set_ylim(y1-.5,y0-.5)
        else:
            ax.set_xlim(ox-.5,ex-.5);ax.set_ylim(ey-.5,oy-.5)
        ax.set_xlabel('source X');ax.set_ylabel('source Y')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,10),layout='constrained')
panels(axes,1232)
fig.suptitle('A / f1232: user-confirmed Foam layer; retained appearance is not a physical segmentation\n'
             'No Oil/Foam front, centre scalar, mask cleanup or component selection is added.',fontsize=12)
fig.savefig(OUT/'a-foam-support.png',dpi=130);plt.close(fig)
shown=preflight['figures']['context_frames']
fig,axes=plt.subplots(len(shown),3,figsize=(14,11),layout='constrained')
for ax,n in zip(axes,shown):panels(ax,n,True)
fig.suptitle('Same fixed source focus in five predeclared frames; all ten readouts are retained\n'
             'Only A/f1232 receives the new Foam-presence interpretation. Focus boxes are not truth masks.',fontsize=12)
fig.savefig(OUT/'water-foam-context-support.png',dpi=130);plt.close(fig)
for name,pin in {**inputs,**source_pins}.items():assert sha(ROOT/name)==pin,name
readout=dict(schema='s11-water-foam-support-readout-v1',preflight_sha256=sha(OUT/'preflight.json'),
    runtime=dict(python=platform.python_version(),opencv=cv2.__version__,numpy=np.__version__),results=results,
    totals=dict(cases=len(results),reused_captures=len(reuse),new_captures=len(results)-len(reuse),
                components=sum(r['retained_count'] for r in results),faces=sum(r['face_count'] for r in results),
                center_crossings=sum(len(r['all_center_crossings']) for r in results)),
    source_inputs_preserved=True,physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED',
    figures={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in OUT.glob('*.png')})
write('readout.json',readout)
print('COMPLETE',readout['totals'],flush=True)

"""Capture unchanged owner locals at return; no replacement segmentation."""
from pathlib import Path
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import os

ROOT=Path.cwd();sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'src')]
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR','/tmp/s11-water-foam-support-mpl')
import cv2
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import DetectorSettings
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.preprocessing import preprocess
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision import foam_front_detector as owner

PARENT=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-water-foam-support-20261010-002'
OUT=PARENT/'stages';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write(n,v):(OUT/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
pre=json.loads((PARENT/'preflight.json').read_text());read=json.loads((PARENT/'readout.json').read_text())
settings=DetectorSettings();assert dataclasses.asdict(settings)==pre['settings']
captured_names=['lightness','chroma','warm_chroma','raw_whiteness','whiteness','texture',
                'textured_white_support','smooth_droplet_support','raw_white_support','white_clean',
                'chromatic_support','chromatic_evidence','recovered_droplet_support',
                'material_visible','material_glare','support']
inputs={str((PARENT/n).relative_to(ROOT)):sha(PARENT/n) for n in ['preflight.json','readout.json']}
inputs.update({r['arrays_path']:r['arrays_sha256'] for r in read['results']})
before=dict(schema='s11-water-foam-stage-readout-preflight-v1',
    base_head=pre['base_head'],inputs=inputs,source_pins=pre['production_source_pins'],
    runner_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),frames=[r['frame_index'] for r in read['results']],
    operation='Use sys.setprofile return events to copy named local arrays from the unchanged Foam owner '
        'and raw chromatic-support return before arbitration. No function replacement, mask edit or settings change.',
    capture_names=captured_names,geometry=pre['geometry'],focus_xyxy=pre['figures']['focus_xyxy'],
    column_source_x=950,column_source_y_range=[440,560],
    queries='All ten frozen cases; same prior focus rectangle and central column. Counts/rows are image '
        'support observations, not dense Foam truth or a candidate recall denominator.',
    equality='Every traced label raster and complete component diagnostic dictionary must equal the '
        'preceding unmodified capture. Inputs must remain byte-equal. No complete application replay.',
    stop_rule='Do not modify brightness, texture, glare, morphology, union, rank or region after results.',
    physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED')
for n,pin in {**inputs,**before['source_pins']}.items():assert sha(ROOT/n)==pin,n
write('preflight.json',before);(OUT/'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
ox,oy,ex,ey=pre['geometry']['crop_xyxy'];x0,y0,x1,y1=before['focus_xyxy']
focus=(slice(y0-oy,y1-oy),slice(x0-ox,x1-ox));col=(slice(440-oy,560-oy),950-ox)
results=[];plots={}
for previous in read['results']:
    n=previous['frame_index']
    with np.load(ROOT/previous['arrays_path'],allow_pickle=False) as old:
        crop=old['crop'].copy();old_labels=old['labels'].copy();old_visible=old['visible'].copy()
    mask=np.full(crop.shape[:2],255,np.uint8);pp=preprocess(crop,mask,settings)
    assert np.array_equal(pp.glare_mask==0,old_visible)
    captured={};branch=[]
    def observe(frame,event,arg):
        if event!='return':return
        if frame.f_code is owner.detect_bottom_connected_foam.__code__:
            for key in captured_names:captured[key]=frame.f_locals[key].copy()
        elif (frame.f_back is not None and frame.f_back.f_code is owner.detect_bottom_connected_foam.__code__):
            if frame.f_code is owner._chromatic_foam_support.__code__:
                captured['pre_arbitration_chromatic_support']=arg[0].copy()
            elif frame.f_code is owner._has_material_nonstructural_support_component.__code__:
                branch.append(bool(arg))
    args=(crop,pp.gray,pp.canny,pp.glare_mask,mask,settings)
    input_hashes=[hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest() for a in args[:-1]]
    saved_profile=sys.getprofile()
    try:
        sys.setprofile(observe)
        result=owner.detect_bottom_connected_foam(*args,capture_diagnostics=True)
    finally:
        sys.setprofile(saved_profile)
    assert len(branch)==1 and set(captured)==set(captured_names)|{'pre_arbitration_chromatic_support'}
    assert np.array_equal(result.diagnostic_labels,old_labels)
    assert result.diagnostics==previous['owner_component_metadata']
    assert input_hashes==[hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest() for a in args[:-1]]
    arrays=dict(gray=pp.gray,canny=pp.canny,glare=pp.glare_mask,retained_labels=old_labels,**captured)
    path=OUT/f'f{n:06d}.npz';np.savez_compressed(path,**arrays)
    stages={}
    for key in ['canny','glare','raw_white_support','white_clean','pre_arbitration_chromatic_support',
                'chromatic_support','recovered_droplet_support','support','retained_labels']:
        active=arrays[key]>0
        stages[key]=dict(focus_pixels=int(active[focus].sum()),
            column_pixels=int(active[col].sum()),source_column_rows=(np.flatnonzero(active[col])+440).tolist())
    raw=arrays['raw_white_support'][col]>0;clean=arrays['white_clean'][col]>0
    row=dict(frame_index=n,white_priority_branch=branch[0],capture_equal_previous=True,
             input_arrays_preserved=True,stages=stages,
